title: Request carrier normalizer and sampled-span pruner
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a request carrier normalizer and a sampled-span pruner to reduce high-cardinality header permutations and control tail-cost of tracing in edge paths. The carrier normalizer will canonicalize incoming propagation headers across HTTP/gRPC/WS/worker-queue transports and translate vendor variants into a single internal carrier shape. The sampled-span pruner will apply deterministic heuristics and pluggable sampling hints to drop low-value span children before export, keeping trace topology useful while bounding telemetry volume.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SDK middleware normalizes X-Redwood-, x-redwood, traceparent, b3, otel and our legacy headers to the canonical carrier with documented schema; 2) Pruner exposes config: max_child_spans_per_parent, min_span_duration_ms, low_entropy_tag_whitelist and sampling_hint_priority; 3) End-to-end tests showing 60-80% reduction in span export volume for noisy clients while preserving root-to-leaf latency percentiles; 4) Backcompat: existing spans still correlate across services when sampling=1 and no header loss occurs; 5) New console dashboard shows expected reduction and traffic-weighted coverage metrics.
design_decisions:
- Use an internal Carrier struct (flat key:value strings) rather than nested JSON to simplify cross-language SDKs.
- Normalize header casing and compact duplicate keys on the edge proxy to avoid combinatorial explosion.
- Implement pruner as a post-instrumentation step in SDKs and as an optional sidecar filter for self-hosted Private deployments.
- Make heuristics deterministic by hashing parent span id with a stable salt to enable reproducible sampling for debug sessions.
implementation_notes:
- Languages: JS/TS, Python, Go SDKs receive first-class adapters.
- Edge proxy (envoy filter) will perform initial header normalization for hosted API path to reduce upstream processing.
- Provide a Runtime flag `tracing.prune.enabled` and per-tenant override.
- Add event to telemetry index when pruner drops > threshold spans for a customer (for billing/alerts).
- Expose pruner metrics: spans_pruned_total, spans_kept_total, pruner_decisions_by_reason{reason}, carrier_normalizations_total.
testing_notes:
- Unit tests: carrier permutations -> canonical form.
- Integration: synth traffic (mixed b3/traceparent/legacy) through edge -> backend services with pruner enabled. Validate trace continuity for sampled roots.
- Load test: run benchmark harness with noisy downstream (10k rps) to measure CPU and network reduction.
- QA: dark-roll pruner for 48h with metrics-only before enabling drops.
- Regression: ensure trace-search still returns root spans when head sampled.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge SDK adapters behind feature flag. 2) Dark-launch carrier normalization on hosted edge (metrics-only for 48h). 3) Enable pruner in SDKs with prune.mode=observe for 7 days. 4) Canary enable pruning for 5% tenants, monitor errors/trace-continuity. 5) Ramp to 50% then 100% with tenant opt-out. 6) Document config and support runbook. 7) Backfill dashboards and run QA playbook.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Maya Chen: Spiked prototype for header normalizer in edge-proxy. Found 7 common vendor variants; normalization rules drafted in Confluence.
2026-02-27 - Arjun Patel: Implemented deterministic pruning hash; initial synthetic run shows 65% span reduction for bursty webhook clients with no loss in root-level latency metrics.
2026-03-01 - SRE review (Lina Rodriguez): Concern about missing span-level logs used by incident runbooks; agreed to emit trace IDs and pruner decisions to logs for 30 days.
2026-03-03 - Product (Evan Kim): Request a per-tenant opt-out flag and a telemetry event so support can notify customers when pruning affects a high percentage of their traces.
2026-03-05 - Arjun Patel: Added metric names and draft dashboard tiles; preparing dark-launch on staging this week.
2026-03-05 - QA (Priya Nair): Added test matrix for HTTP/gRPC/WS/Queue transports; blocked on Envoy image with filter (PR merged, image build queued).
notes: Try to keep carrier normalization rules additive and reversible for debugging. We must avoid header rewriting that breaks authentication or rate-limiting logic. Coordinate with edge-auth and rate-limit owners before enabling normalization for a tenant.
support_runbook: - If customers report missing spans: 1) Toggle prune.mode to observe for tenant; 2) Query pruner_decisions_by_reason and spans_pruned_total for tenant id; 3) If needed, disable pruning and request logs for the affected time window.
observability_requirements: Add dashboard: Tracing -> Pruner Overview with charts: spans_pruned_total (rate), spans_kept_total (rate), pruning_ratio_by_service, carrier_normalizations_total, trace_search_hit_rate_by_sampling. Create alert when pruning_ratio_by_service > 0.5 and trace_error_rate increases by > 0.2%.
